1.1: Shenayim temeim bemet, echad tame tumat shiva veechad tame tumat arev. shelosha temein bemet, shenayim temein tumat shiva veechad tame tumat arev. arbaa temein bemet, shelosha temein tumat shiva veechad tame tumat arev. ketzad shenayim. adam hannogea bemet, tame tumat shiva. veadam hannoge bo, tame tumat arev:
1.2: Ketzad shelosha. kelim hannogim bemet, vechelim bakkelim, temein tumat shiva. hashshelishi, ben adam uven kelim, temein tumat arev:
1.3: Ketzad arbaa. kelim nogin bemet, veadam bakkelim, vechelim baadam, temein tumat shiva. harvii, ben adam ben kelim, tame tumat arev. amar rabbi akiva, yesh li chamishi, hashshappud hattachuv baohel, haohel vehashshappud veadam hannogea bashshappud vechelim baadam, temein tumat shiva. hachamishi, ben adam ben kelim, tame tumat arev. amru lo, en haohel mitchashshev:
1.4: Adam vechelim mittammein bemet. chomer baadam mibbakkelim vechelim mibbaadam. shehakkelim shelosha vehaadam shenayim. chomer baadam, shekkol zeman shehu vaemtza, hen arbaa. vesheeno vaemtza, hen shelosha:
1.5: Adam uvegadim mittammeim bezav. chomer baadam mibbabbegadim, uvabbegadim mibbaadam. shehaadam hannogea bezav metamme vegadim, veen begadim hannogin bezav metammein begadim. chomer babbegadim, shehabbegadim hannosin et hazzav metammein adam, veen adam hannose et hazzav metamme adam:
1.6: Adam eno metamme, ad shettetze nafsho. vaafillu meguyyad, vaafillu goses. zokek layyibbum ufoter min hayyibbum, maachil batteruma ufosel batteruma. vechen behema vechayya enan metammein, ad shettetze nafsham. huttezu rashehem, af al pi shemmefarkesim, temeim, kegon zanav shel letaa shehi mefarkaset:
1.7: Haevarin en lahen shiur, afillu pachot mikkazzayit min hammet, ufachot mikkazzayit min hannevela, ufachot mikkaadasha min hashsheretz, metammein tumatan:
1.8: Matayim vearbaim ushemona evarim baadam, sheloshim befissat haregel, shishsha vechol etzba, asara vakkursal, shenayim bashshok, chamishsha vaarkubba, echad bayyarech, shelosha vakkatlit, achat esre tzelaot, sheloshim befissat hayyad, shishsha vechol etzba, shenayim bakkane, ushenayim bammarpek, echad bazzeroa, vearbaa vakkatef. mea veechad mizze umea veechad mizze. ushemone esre chulyot bashshidra, tisha varosh, shemona vatztzavvar, shishsha vammafteach shel lev, vachamishsha vinkavav. kol echad veechad metamme vemagga uvemassa uveohel. ematay, bizman sheyyesh alehen basar karauy. aval im en alehen basar karauy, metammein bemagga uvemassa, veen metammein beohel:

2.1: Ellu metammein beohel. hammet, vechazzayit min hammet, vechazzayit netzel, umelo tarvad rakav, hashshidra, vehaggulgolet, evar min hammet veevar min hachay sheyyesh alehen basar karauy, rova atzamot merov habbinyan o merov hamminyan. verov binyano verov minyano shel met, af al pi sheen bahem rova, temein. kamma hu rov minyano, mea veesrim vachamishsha:
2.2: Reviit dam, ureviit dam tevusa mimmet echad. rabbi akiva omer, mishshene metim. dam katan sheyyatza chullo, rabbi akiva omer, kol shehu. vachachamim omrim, reviit. kazzayit rimma, ben chayya ben meta, rabbi eliezer metamme chivsaro, vachachamim metaharim. efer serufim, rabbi eliezer omer, shiuro verova, vachachamim metaharin. melo tarvad veod afar kevarot, tame, rabbi shimon metaher. melo tarvad rakav sheggevalo vemayim, eno chibbur letuma:
2.3: Ellu metammein bemagga uvemassa veenan metammein beohel. etzem kasseora, veeretz haammim, uvet happeras, evar min hammet veevar min hachay sheen alehen basar karauy, hashshidra vehaggulgolet shechasaru. kamma hu chesron bashshidra, bet shammay omrim, shete chulyot. uvet hillel omrim, afillu chulya echat. uvaggulgolet, bet shammay omrim, kimlo makdeach. uvet hillel omrim, kede sheyyinnatel min hachay veyamut. beeze makdeach amru, bakkatan shel rofim, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, baggadol shel lishka:
2.4: Haggolel vehaddofek metammein bemagga uveohel, veenan metammein bemassa. rabbi eliezer omer, metammein bemassa. rabbi yehoshua omer, im yesh tachtehen afar kevarot, metammein bemassa. veim lav, enan metammein bemassa. ezehu haddofek, et shehaggolel nishan alav. aval dofek dofkin, tahor:
2.5: Ellu sheim chasru tehorin. kazzayit min hammet, vechazzayit netzel, umelo tarvad rakav, ureviit dam, veetzem kasseora, veevar min hachay shechasar atzmo:
2.6: Hashshidra vehaggulgolet mishshene metim, ureviit dam mishshene metim, verova atzamot mishshene metim, veevar min hammet mishshene metim, veevar min hachay mishshene anashim, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin:
2.7: Etzem kasseora shennechelak lishnayim, rabbi akiva metamme, verabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, lo amru atzamot kasseora, ella etzem kasseora. rova atzamot shenniddakdeku veen bechol echad veechad etzem kasseora, rabbi shimon metaher, vachachamim metammein. evar min hachay shennechelak lishnayim, tahor. rabbi yose metamme. umode sheim nittal chatzaim shehu tahor:

3.1: Kol hametammein beohel shennechleku vehichnisan letoch habbayit, rabbi dosa ven harekinas metaher, vachachamim metammeim. ketzad. hannogea bechishne chatzaye zetim min hannevela o nosan. uvammet, hannogea bechachatzi zayit umaahil al kachatzi zayit, o noge bechachatzi zayit vechachatzi zayit maahil alav, maahil al kishne chatzaye zetim, maahil al kachatzi zayit vechachatzi zayit maahil alav, rabbi dosa ven harekinas metaher, vachachamim metammein. aval hannogea bechachatzi zayit vedavar acher maahil alav veal kachatzi zayit, o maahil al kachatzi zayit vedavar acher maahil alav veal kachatzi zayit, tahor. amar rabbi meir, af baze rabbi dosa ven harekinas metaher, vachachamim metammein. hakkol tame, chutz min hammagga im hammassa, vehammassa im haohel. ze hakkelal, kol shehu mishshem echad, tame. mishshene shemot, tahor:
3.2: Melo tarvad rakav shennitpazzer betoch habbayit, habbayit tame. verabbi shimon metaher. reviit dam shennivlea vetoch habbayit, habbayit tahor. nivlea vichsut, im mitkabbeset veyotze mimmenna reviit dam, temea. veim lav, tehora, shekkol habbalua sheeno yachol latzet, tahor:
3.3: Nishpach baavir, im haya mekomo ketafres veheehil al miktzato, tahor. haya ashboren, o shekkarash, tame. nishpach al haaskuppa vehi ketafres, ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz, vehabbayit maahil alav, tahor. haya ashboren o shekkarash, tame. kol shebbammet, tame, chutz min hashshinnayim vehassear vehatztzipporen. uvishat chibburo, hakkol tame:
3.4: Ketzad. hammet mibbachutz usearo vifnim, habbayit tame. etzem sheyyesh alav kazzayit basar, hichnis miktzato mibbifnim vehabbayit maahil alav, tame. shene atzamot vaalehen kishne chatzae zetim basar, hichnis miktzatam mibbifnim vehabbayit maahil alehem, tame. hayu techuvim bide adam, tahor, sheen chibbure adam chibbur:
3.5: Ezehu dam tevusa. hammet sheyyatza mimmennu sheminit bechayyav usheminit bemoto, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yishmael omer, reviit bechayyav ureviit bemoto, nittal mizze umizze reviit. rabbi elazar berabbi yehuda omer, ze vaze chammayim. ezehu dam tevusa. tzaluv sheddamo shotet venimtza tachtav reviit dam, tame. aval hammet sheddamo menattef venimtza tachtav reviit dam, tahor. rabbi yehuda omer, lo chi, ella hashshotet, tahor. vehamenattef, tame:
3.6: Kazzayit min hammet, pitcho vetefach, vehammet, pitcho vearbaa tefachim, lehatztzil hattuma al happetachim. aval lehotzi hattuma, befoteach tefach. gadol mikkazzayit, kammet. rabbi yose omer, hashshidra vehaggulgolet, kammet:
3.7: Tefach al tefach al rum tefach, merubba, mevi et hattuma, vechotzetz bifne hattuma. ketzad. biv shehu kamur tachat habbayit, yesh bo foteach tefach veyesh bitziato poteach tefach, tuma vetocho, habbayit tahor. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetocho tahor, shedderech hattuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes. yesh bo foteach tefach veen bitziato foteach tefach, hattuma vetocho, habbayit tame. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetocho tahor, shedderech hattuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes. en bo foteach tefach veen bitziato foteach tefach, tuma vetocho, habbayit tame. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetocho tame. echad chor shechararuhu mayim o sheratzim, o sheachalattu mallachat, vechen mirbach shel avanim, vechen sevar shel korot. rabbi yehuda omer, kol ohel sheeno asuy bide adam, eno ohel. umode vishkifim uvislaim:

4.1: Migdal shehu omed baavir, tuma vetocho, kelim shebbeavyo tehorim. tuma veavyo, kelim shebbetocho tehorim. rabbi yose omer, mechetza lemechetza. haya omed betoch habbayit, tuma vetocho, habbayit tame. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetocho tahor, shedderech hattuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes. kelim shebbeno leven haaretz, shebbeno leven hakkotel, shebbeno leven hakkorot, im yesh sham poteach tefach, temein. veim lav, tehorin. tuma sham, habbayit tame:
4.2: Tevat hammigdal, yesh bah poteach tefach veen bitziatah poteach tefach, tuma vetochah, habbayit tame. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetochah tahor, shedderech hattuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes. rabbi yose metaher, mippene shehu yachol lehotziah lachatzaim o lesarfah bimkomah:
4.3: Haya omed betoch happetach veniftach lachutz, tuma vetocho, habbayit tahor. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetocho tame, shedderech hattuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes. hayta mucheni shello meshucha laachorav shalosh etzbaot, tuma sham keneged hakkorot, habbayit tahor. bamme devarim amurim, bizman sheyyesh sham poteach tefach, veenah yotza, vehammigdal ba vemidda:

5.1: Tannur shehu omed betoch habbayit veeno kemura lachutz, veheehilu alav kovre hammet, bet shammay omrim, hakkol tame. uvet hillel omrim, hattannur tame vehabbayit tahor. rabbi akiva omer, af hattannur tahor:
5.2: Arubba shebben habbayit laaliyya, ukedera netuna aleha unekuva vechones mashke, bet shammay omrim, hakkol tame. uvet hillel omrim, hakkedera temea, vaaliyya tehora. rabbi akiva omer, af hakkedera tehora:
5.3: Hayta shelema, bet hillel omrim, matztzelet al hakkol. bet shammay omrim, enah matztzelet ella al hoochalim veal hammashkim veal kele chares. chazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay:
5.4: Lagin shehu male mashkin tehorin, hallagin tame tumat shiva, vehammashkin tehorin. veim pinnan bichli acher, temein. haishsha shehi lasha vaareva, haishsha vehaareva temeim tumat shiva, vehabbatzek tahor. veim pinnattu lichli acher, tame. chazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay:
5.5: Hayu chele gelalim, kele avanim, kele adama, hakkol tahor. haya cheli tahor lakkodesh velachattat, hakkol tahor, shehakkol neemanin al hachattat, mippene shehakkelim tehorin uchele cheres tehorin umatztzilin im dafnot ohalim:
5.6: Ketzad. habbor vehaddut shebbabbayit, uchefisha netuna alav, tahor. im hayta veer chalaka, o chavveret pechuta, uchefisha netuna aleha, tame. im haya neser chalak, o serida sheen lah gappayim, tahor, sheen hakkelim matztzilim im dafnot ohalim ad sheyyehe lahen defanot. vechamma tehe haddofen, tefach. haya lah chatzi tefach mikkan vachatzi tefach mikkan, enah dofen, ad sheyyehe lah tefach mimmakom echad:
5.7: Keshem shemmatztzilin mibbifnim, kach matztzilin mibbachutz. ketzad, kefisha shehi netuna al hayetedot mibbachutz, tuma tachteha, kelim shebbakkefisha tehorim. im haya chotel chatzer o chotel ginna, eno matztzil. kora shehayta netuna mikkotel lechotel ukedera teluya vah, tuma tachteha, kelim shebbakkedera, rabbi akiva metaher, vachachamim metammein:

6.1: Adam vechelim naasin ohalin letamme, aval lo letaher. ketzad. arbaa nosin et hannidbach, tuma tachtav, kelim sheal gabbav temein. tuma al gabbav, kelim shettachtav temeim. rabbi eliezer metaher. natun al arbaa chelim, afillu chele gelalim, kele avanim, kele adama, tuma tachtav, kelim sheal gabbav temeim. tuma al gabbav, kelim shettachtav temeim. natun al arbaa avanim, o al davar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim, tuma tachtav, kelim sheal gabbav tehorin. tuma al gabbav, kelim shettachtav tehorin:
6.2: Kovre hammet shehayu ovrim beachsadra, vehegif achad mehen et haddelet usemacho vammafteach, im yachol haddelet laamod bifne atzmo, tahor. veim lav, tame. vechen chavit shel gerogarot o kuppa shel teven shehen netunot bechallon, im yecholin haggerogarot vehatteven laamod bifne atzman, tehorin. veim lav, temein. bayit shechatzatzo vekankannim vetach betiach, im yachol hattiach laamod bifne atzmo, tahor. veim lav, tame:
6.3: Kotel hameshammesh et habbayit, yiddon mechetza lemechetza. ketzad. kotel shehu laavir vehattuma vetocho, mechetzyo velifnim, habbayit tame, vehaomed milmalan tahor. mechetzyo velachutz, habbayit tahor, vehaomed milmalan tame. mechetza lemechetza, habbayit tame. vehaomed milmalan, rabbi meir metamme, vachachamim metaharin. rabbi yehuda omer, kol hakkotel labbayit:
6.4: Kotel shebben shene vattim vehattuma vetocho, bayit hakkarov lattuma, tame. vehakkarov lattohora, tahor. mechetza lemechetza, shenehem temein. tuma veachad mehen vechelim bakkotel, mechetzyo uchelappe tuma, temein. mechetzyo uchelappe tohora, tehorin. mechetza lemechetza, hare hen temein. maaziva shebben habbayit laaliyya, tuma vetochah, mechetzyah ulemattan, habbayit tame vaaliyya tehora. mechetzyah ulemalan, haaliyya temea vehabbayit tahor. mechetza lemechetza, shenehen temein. tuma veachad mehen vechelim bammaaziva, mechetzyah uchelappe tuma, temein. mechetzyah uchelappe tohora, tehorin. mechetza lemechetza, hare hen temein. rabbi yehuda omer, kol hammaaziva laaliyya:
6.5: Tuma ven hakkorot vetachteha chiklippat hashshum, im yesh sham poteach tefach, hakkol tame. im en sham poteach tefach, roin et hattuma keillu hi otem. hayta niret betoch habbayit, ben kach uven kach, habbayit tame:
6.6: Bayit hameshammesh et hakkotel, yiddon kiklippat hashshum. ketzad. kotel shebben shene chuchin, o ven shete mearot, tuma vabbattim vechelim bakkotel vaalehem kiklippat hashshum, tehorin. tuma vakkotel vechelim babbattim vealeha chiklippat hashshum, tehorin. tuma tachat haammud, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet:
6.7: Kelim shettachat happerach, tehorim. rabbi yochanan ben nuri metamme. hattuma vehakkelim shettachat happerach, im yesh sham poteach tefach, temein. veim lav, tehorin. shene fardaskim ze vetzad ze, o ze al gav ze, niftach achad mehen, hu vehabbayit tame, vachavero tahor. veroin et happardaskin keillu hu otem, yiddon mechetza lemechetza lehavi et hattuma labbayit:

7.1: Hattuma vakkotel, umekomah tefach al tefach al rum tefach, kol haaliyyot sheal gabbah, afillu hen eser, temeot. hayta aliyya achat al gabbe shene vattim, hi temea, vechol haaliyyot sheal gabbah, tehorot. kotel shanit, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. nefesh atuma, hannogea bah min hatztzedadin, tahor, mippene shettuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. im haya mekom hattuma tefach al tefach al rum tefach, hannogea bah mikkol makom, tame, mippene shehi chekever satum. samach lah sukkot, temeot. rabbi yehuda metaher:
7.2: Kol shippue ohalin, kaohalin. ohel shehu shofea veyored, vechale ad keetzba, tuma vaohel, kelim shettachat hashshippua, temeim. tuma tachat hashshippua, kelim shebbaohel, temein. tuma mittocho, hannogea bo mittocho, tame tumat shiva. umeachorav, tame tumat arev. tuma meachorav, hannogea bo meachorav, tame tumat shiva. mittocho, tame tumat arev. kachatzi zayit mittocho vechachatzi zayit meachorav, hannogea bo, ben mittocho ben meachorav, tame tumat arev. miktzato meruddad al haaretz, tuma tachtav o al gabbav, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. ohel shehu natuy baaliyya, miktzato meruddad al haarubba shebben bayit laaliyya, rabbi yose omer, matztzil. rabbi shimon omer, eno matztzil, ad sheyyehe natuy kintiyyat haohel:
7.3: Hammet babbayit uvo fetachin harebe, kullan temein. niftach achad mehen, hu tame vechullan tehorim. chashav lehotzio veachad mehen, o vechallon shehu arbaa al arbaa tefachim, hitztzil al kol happetachim. bet shammay omrim, yachshov ad shello yamut hammet. bet hillel omrim, af mishshemmet. haya satum venimlach lefatcho, bet shammay omrim, kesheyyiftach arbaa tefachim. uvet hillel omrim, kesheyyatchil. umodim befoteach battechilla, sheyyiftach arbaa tefachim:
7.4: Haishsha shehi maksha leled vehotziuha mibbayit levayit, harishon tame vesafek, vehashsheni bevadday. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shehi nittelet baggappayim. aval im hayta mehallechet, harishon tahor, shemmishshenniftach hakkever en penay lehallech. en lannefalim petichat hakkever, ad sheyyagilu rosh kefika:
7.5: Yatza harishon met vehashsheni chay, tahor. harishon chay vehashsheni met, tame. rabbi meir omer, beshafir echad, tame. bishne shefirim, tahor:
7.6: Haishsha shehi maksha leled, mechattechin et havvalad bemeeha umotziin oto evarim evarim, mippene shechayyeha kodmin lechayyav. yatza rubbo, en nogin bo, sheen dochin nefesh mippene nafesh:

8.1: Yesh meviin et hattuma vechotztzin, meviin et hattuma velo chotztzin, chotztzin velo meviin, lo meviin velo chotztzin. ellu meviin vechotztzin, hashshidda vehatteva vehammigdal, kavveret hakkash, kavveret hakkanim, uvor sefina alekkesanderit, sheyyesh lahen shulayim vehen machazikim arbaim sea velach, shehem korayim beyavesh. viria, usekorteya, uketavolya, vesadin, umappatz, umachatzelet, shehen asuyin ohalim, veeder behema temea utehora, umechonot chayya vaof, vehaof sheshshachan, vehaose makom levena bashshibbolim, haerus vehakkissom, veyarkot chamor, udelaat yevanit, veochalim tehorim. rabbi yochanan ben nuri lo haya mode beochalim tehorin, chutz min haiggul shel devela:
8.2: Hazzizin, vehaggizriyyot, vehashshovachot, vehashshekifim, vehasselaim, vehaggeharim, vehashshenanim, vehassechachot, vehapperaot, shehen yecholim lekabbel maaziva rakka, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, maaziva venonit. ellu hen hassechachot, ilan shehu mesech al haaretz. vehapperaot, hayyotzot min haggader:
8.3: Ellu meviin velo chotztzin. hashshidda, vehatteva, vehammigdal, kavveret hakkash, kavveret hakkanim, uvor sefina alekkesanderit, sheen lahem shulayim veenan machazikim arbaim sea velach, shehem korayim beyavesh. viria, usekorteya, uketavolya, vesadin, umappatz, umachatzelet, sheen asuyin ohalim, uvehema vechayya shemmetu, veochalim temeim. musaf alehem, harechayim shel adam:
8.4: Ellu chotztzim velo meviin. massechet perusa, vachavile hammitta, vehammishpalot vehasserigot shebbachalonot:
8.5: Ellu lo meviin velo chotztzin. hazzeraim vehayerakot hamechubbarim lakkarka, chutz min hayerakot shemmanu, vechippat habbarad, vehashsheleg, vehakkefor, vehaggelid, vehammelach, vehaddoleg mimmakom lemakom, vehakkofetz mimmakom lemakom, vehaof happoreach, vetallit hamenafnefet, usefina shehi shata al pene hammayim. kashar et hassefina bedavar shehu yachol lehaamidah, kavash et haeven al gabbe hattallit, mevia et hattuma. rabbi yose omer, habbayit shebbassefina eno mevi et hattuma:
8.6: Shete chaviyyot uvahen kishne chatzaye zetim, mukkafot tzamid patil umunnachot betoch habbayit, hen tehorot, vehabbayit tame. niftecha achat mehen, hi vehabbayit temeim vachavertah tehora. vechen shene chadarim shehen petuchin labbayit:

9.1: Kavveret shehi vetoch happetach ufiha lachutz, kazzayit min hammet natun tachteha o al gabbah mibbachutz, kol shehu cheneged hazzayit, tachteha vegabbah tame. vechol sheeno cheneged hazzayit, tochah, vehabbayit, tahor. babbayit, en tame ella habbayit. betochah, hakkol tame:
9.2: Hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha o vabbayit o al gabbah, hakkol tame, ella tochah. betochah, hakkol tame:
9.3: Bamme devarim amurim, bizman shehi cheli mechulchalet. hayta fechuta ufekuka vekash o afutza, ezo hi afutza, kol sheen lah tefach mimmakom echad, kazzayit min hammet natun tachteha, kenegdo ad hattehom tame. al gabbah, kenegdo ad harakia tame. babbayit, en tame ella habbayit. betochah, en tame ella tochah:
9.4: Hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha o vabbayit, tachteha vehabbayit tame, tochah vegabbah tahor. betochah, en tame ella tochah. al gabbah, kenegdo ad harakia tame:
9.5: Bamme devarim amurim, bizman sheppiha lachutz. haya fiha lifnim, vechazzayit min hammet natun tachteha o al gabbah mibbachutz, kol shehu cheneged hazzayit, tachteha vegabbah vetochah tame. vechol sheeno cheneged hazzayit, tochah vehabbayit tahor. betochah o vabbayit, hakkol tame:
9.6: Hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha o vabbayit o vetochah o al gabbah, hakkol tame:
9.7: Bamme devarim amurim, bizman shehi cheli mechulchalet. hayta fechuta ufekuka vekash o afutza, ezohi afutza, kol sheen lah tefach mimmakom echad, kazzayit min hammet natun tachteha, kenegdo ad hattehom tame. al gabbah, kenegdo ad harakia tame. betochah o vabbayit, tochah vehabbayit temeim:
9.8: Hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha o vabbayit o vetochah, hakkol tame, ella gabbah. al gabbah, kenegdo ad harakia tame:
9.9: Hayta memallea et kol habbayit veen benah leven hakkorot poteach tefach, tuma vetochah, habbayit tame. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetochah tahor, shedderech tuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes, ben omedet ben mutta al tziddah, ben achat ben shetayim:
9.10: Hayta omedet betoch happetach veen benah leven hammashkof poteach tefach, tuma vetochah, habbayit tahor. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetochah tame, shedderech hattuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes:
9.11: Hayta mutta al tziddah baavir vechazzayit min hammet natun tachteha o al gabbah, kol shehu cheneged hazzayit, tachteha vegabbah, tame. vechol sheeno cheneged hazzayit, tochah, tahor. betochah, hakkol tame:
9.12: Hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha o al gabbah, hakkol tame, ella tochah. betochah, hakkol tame. bamme devarim amurim, bizman shehi cheli. hayta fechuta ufekuka vekash, o machazeket arbaim sea, kedivre chachamim, kazzayit min hammet natun tachteha, kenegdo ad hattehom tame. al gabbah, kenegdo ad harakia, tame. betochah, en tame ella tochah. hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha, tame. betochah, tochah tame. al gabbah, kenegdo ad harakia tame:
9.13: Hayta yoshevet al shuleha vehi cheli, tuma tachteha, betochah, o al gabbah, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, o mechussa, o chefuya al piha, tuma tachteha, betochah, o al gabbah, hakkol tame:
9.14: Bamme devarim amurim, bizman shehi cheli. hayta fechuta ufekuka vekash, o machazeket arbaim sea kedivre chachamim, tuma tachteha, betochah, o al gabbah, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. rabbi eliezer verabbi shimon omrim, en tuma ola lah, af lo yoredet mimmenna. hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha, tachteha tame. betochah, o al gabbah, kenegdo ad harakia tame:
9.15: Aron shehi rechava millemattan vetzara milmalan vehammet betochah, hannogea bah millemattan, tahor. umilmalan, tame. rechava milmalan vetzara millemattan, hannogea bah mikkol makom, tame. hayta shava, hannogea bah mikkol makom, tame, divre rabbi eliezer. verabbi yehoshua omer, mittefach ulemattan, tahor. mittefach ulemalan, tame. haasuya chemin kamtera, hannoge bah mikkol makom, tame. kemin geloskos, hannogea bah mikkol makom, tahor, chutz mimmekom petichatah:
9.16: Chavit shehi yoshevet al shuleha vaavir vechazzayit min hammet natun tachteha o vetochah keneged kurekuratah, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoredet, vehechavit temea. tachat dafnah mibbachutz, tuma bokaat veola, bokaat veyoredet, vehechavit tehora. betochah vetachat dafnah, im yesh baddefanot poteach tefach, hakkol tame, ucheneged piha, tahor. veim lav, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. bamme devarim amurim, bithora. aval im hayta temea o gevoha min haaretz tefach o mechussa o chefuya al piha, tuma tachteha, betochah o al gabbah, hakkol tame:

10.1: Arubba shehi vetoch habbayit veyesh bah poteach tefach, tuma vabbayit, keneged arubba tahor. tuma cheneged arubba, habbayit tahor. hattuma ben babbayit uven keneged arubba, natan et raglo milmalan, erev et hattuma. miktzat tuma vabbayit umiktzatah keneged arubba, habbayit tame, ucheneged hattuma tame:
10.2: En baarubba poteach tefach, tuma vabbayit, keneged arubba tahor. tuma cheneged arubba, habbayit tahor. hattuma vabbayit, natan et raglo milmalan, tahor. hattuma cheneged arubba, natan et raglo milmalan, rabbi meir metamme. vachachamim omrim, im tuma kadma et raglo, tame. im raglo kadma et hattuma, tahor. rabbi shimon omer, shete raglayim, zo al gav zo, shekkadmu et hattuma, mashach harishon et raglo venimtza raglo shel sheni sham, tahor, mippene shekkadma raglo shel rishon et hattuma:
10.3: Miktzat tuma vabbayit umiktzatah keneged arubba, habbayit tame, ucheneged hattuma tame, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, habbayit tame, keneged hattuma tahor. rabbi yose omer, im yesh battuma chede shettechalek utetamme et habbayit utetamme cheneged hattuma, tame. veim lav, habbayit tame, keneged hattuma tahor:
10.4: Arubbot zo al gav zo, veyesh bahen poteach tefach, tuma vabbayit, keneged arubbot tahor. tuma cheneged arubbot, habbayit tahor. hattuma ben babbayit ben keneged arubbot, natan davar shehu mekabbel tuma, ben milmalan ben millemattan, hakkol tame. vedavar sheeno mekabbel tuma, mimmennu ulemattan, tame. mimmennu ulemalan, tahor:
10.5: En baarubbot poteach tefach, tuma vabbayit, keneged arubbot tahor. tuma cheneged arubbot, habbayit tahor. hattuma vabbayit, natan ben davar shehu mekabbel tuma, ben davar sheeno mekabbel tuma, ben milmalan ben millemattan, en tame ella hattachton. hattuma cheneged arubbot, natan davar shehu mekabbel tuma, ben milmalan ben millemattan, hakkol tame. vedavar sheeno mekabbel tuma, ben milmalan ben millemattan, en tame ella tachton:
10.6: Arubba shehi vetoch habbayit ukedera netuna tachteha, sheim taale, en siftoteha nogot baarubba, tuma tachteha, betochah o al gabbah, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha, o vabbayit, tachteha vehabbayit, tame. tochah vegabbah, tahor. betochah o al gabbah, hakkol tame:
10.7: Haytah netuna vetzad haaskuppa sheim taale hi nogaat bammashkof poteach tefach, tuma tachteha, betochah o al gabbah, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha o vabbayit, tachteha vehabbayit tame, tochah vegabbah tahor. betochah o al gabbah, hakkol tame. sheim taale enah nogaat bashshekof poteach tefach, o mudbeket bashshekof, tuma tachteha, en tame ella tachteha:

11.1: Habbayit shennisdak, tuma vachutz, kelim shebbifnim tehorin. tuma vifnim, kelim shebbachutz, bet shammay omrim, ad sheyyehe vassedek arbaa tefachim. bet hillel omrim, kol shehu. rabbi yose omer mishshum bet hillel, poteach tafach:
11.2: Achsadra shennisdeka, tuma vetzad ze, kelim shebbatztzad hashsheni tehorim. natan et raglo o kane milmalan, erev et hattuma. natan et hakkane vaaretz, eno mevi et hattuma, ad sheyyihye gavoah min haaretz poteach tafach:
11.3: Sagos ave vechofet ave enan meviin et hattuma ad sheyyihyu gevohim min haaretz poteach tefach. kefulim, zo al gabbe zo, enan meviot et hattuma ad shettehe haelyona gevoha min haaretz poteach tefach. haya adam natun sham, bet shammay omrim, eno mevi et hattuma. uvet hillel omrim, adam chalul hu, vehatztzad haelyon mevi et hattuma:
11.4: Haya mashkif bead hachallon veheehil al kovre hammet, bet shammay omrim, eno mevi et hattuma. uvet hillel omrim, mevi et hattuma. umodim, sheim haya lavush bechelav, o shehayu shenayim ze al gabbe ze, shehem meviin et hattuma:
11.5: Haya muttal al haaskuppa veheehilu alav kovre hammet, bet shammay omrim, eno mevi et hattuma. uvet hillel omrim, mevi et hattuma:
11.6: Hattuma vabbayit veheehilu alav tehorin, bet shammay metaharin, uvet hillel metammein:
11.7: Kelev sheachal besar hammet umet hakkelev umuttal al haaskuppa, rabbi meir omer, im yesh betzavvaro poteach tefach, mevi et hattuma. veim lav, eno mevi et hattuma. rabbi yose omer, roin et hattuma, mikkeneged hammashkof velifnim, habbayit tame. mikkeneged hammashkof velachutz, habbayit tahor. rabbi eliezer omer, piv lifnim, habbayit tahor. piv lachutz, habbayit tame, shehattuma yotzet derech shulav. rabbi yehuda ven betera omer, ben kach uven kach, habbayit tame. kamma tishhe vemeav. shelosha yamim meet leet. beofot uvedagim, kede shettippol laur vetissaref, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda ven betera omer, beofot uvedagim, meet leet:
11.8: Hechadut shebbabbayit umenora vetocho, vehapperach shellah yotze uchefisha netuna alav, sheim tinnatel hammenora uchefisha omedet al pi hechadut, bet shammay omrim, hechadut tahor, umenora temea. bet hillel omrim, af hammenora tehora. umodim, sheim tinnatel hammenora uchefisha nofelet, hakkol tame:
11.9: Kelim shebben sifte chefisha leven sifte hechadut, afillu ad hattehom, tehorim. tuma sham, habbayit tame. tuma vabbayit, kelim shebbechatle hechadut, im yesh bimkoman tefach al tefach al rum tefach, tehorim. veim lav, temeim. im hayu chatle hechadut rechavim mishshel bayit, ben kach uven kach tehorim:

12.1: Neser shehu natun al pi tannur chadash veodef mikkol tzedadav befoteach tefach, tuma tachtav, kelim sheal gabbav tehorim. tuma al gabbav, kelim shettachtav tehorim. uveyashan, tame. rabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher. natun al pi shene tannurim, tuma venehem, hem temeim. rabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher:
12.2: Sereda shehi netuna al pi hattannur mukkaf tzamid patil, tuma tachtav o al gabbav, hakkol tame. keneged aviro shel tannur, tahor. tuma cheneged aviro shel tannur, kenegdo ad harakia tame:
12.3: Neser shehu natun al pi tannur yashan, yotze mizze umizze tefach aval lo min hatztzedadim, tuma vetzad ze, kelim shebbatztzad hashsheni tehorim. rabbi yose metamme. habbetach eno mevi et hattuma. haya vo ziz, rabbi eliezer omer, eno mevi et hattuma. rabbi yehoshua omer, roim et habbetach keillu eno, vehazziz haelyon mevi et hattuma:
12.4: Sandal shel arisa sheppechato vetoch habbayit, im yesh bo poteach tefach, hakkol tame. veim lav, monin bo chederech shemmonin bemet:
12.5: Korot habbayit vehaaliyya sheen alehen maaziva vehen mechuvvanot, tuma tachat achat mehen, tachteha tame. ben hattachtona laelyona, benehen tame. al gabbe haelyona, kenegdo ad harakia tame. hayu haelyonot keven hattachtonot, tuma tachat achat mehen, tachat kullam tame. al gabbehen, kenegdo ad harakia tame:
12.6: Kora shehi netuna mikkotel lechotel vetuma tachteha, im yesh bah poteach tefach, mevia et hattuma tachat kullah. veim lav, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. kamma yihye vehekkefah vihe vah poteach tefach. bizman shehi agulla, hekkefah shelosha tefachim. bizman shehi merubbaat, arbaa, shehamerubba yater al heagol revia:
12.7: Ammud shehu muttal laavir, im yesh behekkefo esrim vearbaa tefachim, mevi et hattuma tachat dafno. veim lav, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet:
12.8: Kazzayit min hammet mudbak laaskuppa, rabbi eliezer metamme et habbayit. rabbi yehoshua metaher. haya natun tachat haaskuppa, yiddon mechetza lemechetza. mudbak lammashkof, habbayit tame. rabbi yose metaher. haya natun betoch habbayit, hannogea bammashkof, tame. hannogea baaskuppa, rabbi eliezer metamme. rabbi yehoshua omer, mittefach ulemattan, tahor. mittefach ulemalan, tame:

13.1: Haose maor battechilla, shiuro melo makdeach gadol shel lishka. sheyare hammaor, rum etzbaayim al rochav haggudal. ellu hen sheyare hammaor, challon shessetamah velo hispik legamrah. chararuhu mayim o sheratzim o sheachalattu mallachat, shiuro melo egrof. chashav alav letashmish, shiuro foteach tefach. lemaor, shiuro melo makdeach. hasserigot veharfafot mitztarfot kimlo makdeach, kedivre vet shammay. bet hillel omrim, ad sheyyehe vemakom echad melo makdeach. lehavi hattuma ulehotzi hattuma. rabbi shimon omer, lehavi hattuma, aval lehotzi et hattuma befoteach tafach:
13.2: Challon shehi laavir, shiurah melo makdeach. bana vayit chutza lah, shiurah befoteach tefach. natan et hattikra veemtza hachallon, hattachton befoteach tefach, vehaelyon melo makdeach:
13.3: Hachor shebbaddelet, shiuro melo egrof, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi tarfon omer, befoteach tefach. shiyyer bah hecharash millemattan o milmalan, hegifah velo merkah, o sheppetachattu haruach, shiuro melo egrof:
13.4: Haose makom lekane, uleispati, ulener, shiuro kol shehu, kedivre vet shammay. bet hillel omrim, befoteach tefach. lazun et enav, uledabber im chavero, uletashmish, befoteach tafach:
13.5: Ellu memaatin et hattefach. pachot mikkazzayit basar memaet al yede rova atzamot, ufachot meetzem kasseora memaet al yede chazzayit basar. pachot mikkazzayit min hammet, pachot mikkazzayit min hannevela, pachot mikkaadasha min hashsheretz, pachot mikkabbetza ochalim, hattevua shebbachallon, vechachay sheyyesh bah mammash, venivlat haof hattahor shello chishshav aleha, venivlat of hattame shechishshav aleha velo hichshirah, o hichshirah velo chishshav aleha:
13.6: Ellu sheenan memaatim. en haetzem memaet al yede atzamot, velo vasar al yede vasar, velo chazzayit min hammet, velo chazzayit min hannevela, velo chaadasha min hashsheretz, velo chabbetza ochalim, velo tevua shebbachallonot, velo chachay sheen bah mammash, velo nivlat haof hattahor shechishshav aleha, velo nivlat of hattame shechishshav aleha vehichshirah, velo hashsheti vehaerev hamenuggaim, velo levena mibbet happeras, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, hallevena memaetet, mippene sheafarah tahor. ze hakkelal, hattahor memaet, vehattame eno memaet:

14.1: Hazziz mevi et hattuma kol shehu. haggizra vehaggavlit, befoteach tefach. ezehu hazziz, sheppanav lematta. vehaggizra, sheppaneha lemala. uvamma amru hazziz mevi et hattuma chol shehu, beziz shehu gavoah min happetach shelosha nidbachin, shehem shenem asar tefach. yater mikkan, mevi et hattuma vefoteach tefach. haatarot vehappittuchim meviin et hattuma vefoteach tafach:
14.2: Ziz sheal gabbe happetach, mevi et hattuma vefoteach tefach. sheal gabbe hachallon, rum etzbaayim, sheal gabbe melo makdeach, kol shehu. rabbi yose omer, meloo:
14.3: Kane sheal gabbe happetach, afillu gavoah mea amma, mevi et hattuma chol shehu, divre rabbi yehoshua. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, al yachmor ze min hazziz:
14.4: Ziz shehu sovev et kol habbayit veochel bappetach shalosh etzbaot, tuma vabbayit, kelim shettachtav temeim. tuma tachtav, rabbi eliezer metamme et habbayit, verabbi yehoshua metaher. vechen bechatzer shehi mukkefet achsadra:
14.5: Shene zizin ze al gabbe ze veyesh bahen poteach tefach uvenehen poteach tefach, tuma tachtehen, tachtehen tame. benehem, benehen tame. al gabbehen, kenegdo ad larakia tame. haya haelyon odef al hattachton poteach tefach, tuma tachtehen o venehen, tachtehen uvenehen tame. al gabbehen, kenegdo ad larakia tame. haya haelyon odef al hattachton pachot mittefach, tuma tachtehen, tachtehen uvenehen tame. benehen o tachat hammotar, rabbi eliezer omer, tachtehen uvenehen tame. rabbi yehoshua omer, benehen vetachat hammotar, tame, vetachtehen, tahor:
14.6: Yesh bahen poteach tefach veen benehen poteach tefach, tuma tachtehen, tachtehen tame. benehen o al gabbehen, kenegdo ad harakia tame:
14.7: En bahen poteach tefach, ben sheyyesh benehen poteach tefach ben sheen benehen poteach tefach, tuma tachtehen, benehen o al gabbehen, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. vechen shete yeriot shehen gevohot min haaretz poteach tafach:

15.1: Sagos ave vechofet ave, enan meviin et hattuma, ad sheyyehu gevohin min haaretz poteach tefach. kefulin zo al gabbe zo, enan meviot et hattuma, ad shettehe haelyona gevoha min haaretz poteach tefach. tavlayot shel etz zo al gav zo enan meviot et hattuma, ad shettehe haelyona gevoha min haaretz poteach tefach. veim hayu shel shayish, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet:
15.2: Tavlayot shel etz shehen nogot zo vazo vekarnotehem vehen gevohot min haaretz poteach tefach, tuma tachat achat mehen, hannogea bashsheniyya, tame tumat shiva, kelim shettachat harishona temeim, veshettachat hashsheniyya tehorin. hashshulchan eno mevi et hattuma, ad sheyyehe vo ribbua befoteach tafach:
15.3: Chaviyyot shehen yoshvot al shulehen o muttot al tziddehen, baavir, vehen nogot zo vazo befoteach tefach, tuma tachat achat mehen, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. bamme devarim amurim, bithorot. aval im hayu temeot o gevohot min haaretz poteach tefach, tuma tachat achat mehen, tachat kullam tame:
15.4: Bayit shechatzatzo vinsarim o viriot, min hatztzedadim o min hakkorot, tuma vabbayit, kelim shebbachatzatz tehorim. tuma vachatzatz, kelim shebbabbayit temein. kelim shebbachatzatz, im yesh sham poteach tefach, temeim. veim lav, tehorim:
15.5: Chatzatzo meartzo, tuma vachatzatz, kelim shebbabbayit temeim. tuma vabbayit, kelim shebbachatzatz, im yesh bimkoman tefach al tefach al rum tefach, tehorim. veim lav, temein, sheartzo shel bayit kamohu ad hattehom:
15.6: Bayit shehu male teven veen beno leven hakkorot poteach tefach, tuma vifnim, kelim shekkeneged yetzia temeim. tuma vachutz, kelim shebbifnim, im yesh bimkomam tefach al tefach al rum tefach, tehorim. veim lav, temeim. im yesh ben teven lakkorot poteach tefach, ben kach uven kach temeim:
15.7: Bayit shemmilo afar o tzerorot, uvittelo, vechen keri shel tevua, o gal shel tzerorot, afillu chegallo shel achan, vaafillu tuma vetzad hakkelim, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet:
15.8: Chatzar hakkever, haomed betochah tahor, ad sheyhe vah arba ammot, kedivre vet shammay. bet hillel omrim, arbaa tefachim. kora sheasaah golel lekever, ben omedet ben mutta al tziddah, en tame ella cheneged happetach. asa roshah golel lekever, en tame ella ad arbaa tefachim. uvizman shehu atid lagod, rabbi yehuda omer, kullah chibbur:
15.9: Chavit shehi melea mashkim tehorim umukkefet tzamid patil, vaasaah golel lekever, hannogea bah, tame tumat shiva, vehechavit vehammashkin tehorin. behema sheasaah golel lekever, hannogea bah, tame tumat shiva. rabbi meir omer, kol sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim eno metamme mishshum golel:
15.10: Hannogea bemet vehannogea bechelim, hammaahil al hammet vehannogea bechelim, temein. maahil al hammet umaahil al hakkelim, hanogea bemet umaahil al hakkelim, tehorim. im yesh beyado foteach tefach, temein. shene vattim uvahen kishne chatzae zetim, pashat et shete yadav lahen, im yesh beyadav poteach tefach, mevi et hattuma. veim lav, eno mevi et hattuma:

16.1: Kol hammittaltelin meviin et hattuma koovi hammardea. amar rabbi tarfon, akappach et banay shezzo halacha mekuppachat, sheshshama hashshomea, vetaa, shehaikkar over vehammardea al ketefo, veheehil tziddo echad al hakkever, vetimmeuhu mishshum kelim hammaahilim al hammet. amar rabbi akiva, ani atakken sheyyehu divre chachamim kayyamin, sheyyehu chol hammittaltelin meviin et hattuma al adam hannosan boovi hammardea, veal atzman bechol shehen, veal shear adam vechelim befoteach tafach:
16.2: Ketzad. kush shehu tachuv bakkotel, kachatzi zayit mittachtav vechachatzi zayit meal gabbav, af al pi sheenan mechuvvanin, tame. nimtza mevi et hattuma leatzmo bechol shehu. hakkaddar shehu over vehassal al ketefo veheehil tziddo achat al hakkever, hakkelim shebbatztzad hashsheni tehorin. im yesh bassal poteach tefach, temeim. hatteluliyyot hakkerovot ben lair ben ladderech, echad chadashot veechad yeshanot, temeot. harchokot, chadashot tehorot vishanot temeot. ezo hi kerova, chamishshim amma. vishana, shishshim shana, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, kerova, sheen kerova mimmenna. vishana, sheen adam zochrah:
16.3: Hammotze met battechilla mushkav kedarko, notlo veet tevusato. matza shenayim, notlan veet tevusatan. matza shelosha, im yesh ben ze laze mearba ammot vead shemone kimlo mitta vekovreha, hare zo shechunat kevarot. bodek mimmennu ulehallan esrim amma. matza echad besof esrim amma, bodek mimmennu ulehallan esrim amma, sheraglayim laddavar. sheillu mittechilla metzao, notlo veet tevusato:
16.4: Habbodek, bodek amma al amma umanniach amma, ad shehu maggia lesela o livtula. hamotzi et heafar mimmekom tuma, ochel bedimo. hamefakkeach baggal, eno ochel bedimo:
16.5: Haya vodek, higgia lenachal o lishlulit, o lederech harabbim, mafsik. sade shennehergu vah harugim, melakket etzem etzem vehakkol tahor. hamefanne kivro mittoch sadehu, melakket etzem etzem vehakkol tahor. bor shemmattilim letocho nefalim o harugim, melakket etzem etzem vehakkol tahor. rabbi shimon omer, im hitkino lekever mittechilla, yesh lo tevusa:

17.1: Hachoresh et hakkever, hare ze ose vet happeras. ad kamma hu ose. melo maana mea amma, bet arbaat seim. rabbi yose omer, bet chamesh, bemorad. uvemaale, noten rova karshinim al borech hammacharesha, ad mekom sheyyitzmechu shelosha charshinin zo vetzad zo, ad sham hu ose vet happeras. rabbi yose omer, bemorad velo vemaale:
17.2: Haya choresh vehittiach besela o vegader o shennier hammacharesha, ad sham hu ose vet happeras. rabbi elazar omer, bet peras ose vet peras. rabbi yehoshua omer, peamim ose, peamim eno ose. ketzad. charash chatzi maana, vechazar vecharash chetzyah, vechen hatztzedadin, hare ze ose vet peras. charash melo maana, chazar vecharash mimmenna velachutz, eno ose vet peras:
17.3: Hachoresh melatamya, mitztzevirat haatzamot, missade sheavad hakkever betochah, o shennimtza vah kever, hachoresh et sheeno shello, vechen nachri shecharash, eno ose otah bet peras, sheen bet peras lakkutiyyim:
17.4: Sede vet happeras al gabbe tehora, shatfu geshamim mibbet peras lattehora, afillu adumma vehilbinuha o levana vehedimuha, en osin otah bet happeras:
17.5: Sade sheavad kever betochah, uvana vah bayit vaaliyya al gabbav, im hayta fitchah shel aliyya mechuvvan keneged pitcho shel bayit, aliyya tehora. veim lav, aliyya temea. afar bet happeras vaafar chutza laaretz shebba veyarak, mitztarfin kechotam hammartzufim, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyihye vemakom echad kechotam hammartzufin. amar rabbi yehuda, maase shehayu iggerot baot mimmedinat hayyam livne chohanim gedolim, vehayu vahem kisa uchesatayim chotamot, velo chashu lahem chachamim mishshum tuma:

18.1: Ketzad botzrim bet happeras. mazzim al haadam veal hakkelim, veshonim uvotzrim umotziim chutz levet happeras, vaacherim mekabbelim mehem umolichim laggat. im nagu ellu vaellu, temeim, kedivre vet hillel. bet shammay omrim, ochez et hammaggal besiv, o votzer betzor venoten letoch hakkefisha umolich laggat. amar rabbi yose, bamme devarim amurim, becherem hannaasa vet happeras. aval notea bet happeras, yimmacher lashshuk:
18.2: Shelosha vet perasot hen, hachoresh et hakkever, nittaat kol neta, veenah nizraat kol zera, chutz mizzera hanniktzar. veim akaro, tzover et garno letocho vechovro vishte chevarot, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, hattevua bishte chevarot, vehakkitniyyot beshalosh kevarot. vesoref et hakkash veet heatza, umetamme vemagga uvemassa, veeno metamme veohel:
18.3: Sade sheavad kever betochah, nizraat kol zera, veenah nittaat kol neta. veen mekayyemin bah ilanot, chutz meilan serak sheeno ose ferot. umetamme vemagga uvemassa uveohel:
18.4: Sede vochin, lo nittaat, velo nizraat, vaafarah tahor, veosin mimmenna tannurim lakkodesh. umodim bet shammay uvet hillel shebbodkim leose fesach, veen bodkin litruma. ulenazir, bet shammay omrim, bodkin. uvet hillel omrim, en bodkin. ketzad hu vodek. mevi et heafar shehu yachol lahasito venoten letoch kevara shennekaveha dakkim, umemache, im nimtza sham etzem kasseora, tame:
18.5: Ketzad metaharin bet happeras. notlin mimmennu shelosha tefachim, o noten al gabbav shelosha tefachim. im natal mechetzyo echad shelosha tefachim, venatan al gabbe chetzyo acher shelosha tefachim, tahor. rabbi shimon omer, afillu natal mimmennu tefach umechetza, venatan alav tefach umechetza mimmakom acher, tahor. harotzef bet happeras baavanim sheeno yachol lahasitan, tahor. rabbi shimon omer, af haozek bet happeras, tahor:
18.6: Hamehallech bevet happeras al avanim sheeno yachol lahasitan, al haadam veal habbehema shekkochan yafe, tahor. al avanim shehu yachol lahasitan, al haadam veal habbehema shekkochan ra, tame. hamehallech beeretz haammim, beharim uvasselaim, tame. bayyam uvashshunit, tahor. veezehu hashshunit, kol makom shehayyam ole vezapo:
18.7: Hakkone sade vesureya, semucha leeretz yisrael, im yachol lehikkanes lah betohora, tehora, vechayyevet bammaasrot uvashsheviit. veim eno yachol lehikkanes lah betohora, temea, vechayyevet bammaasrot uvashsheviit. medorot haggoyim, temein. kamma yishhe vetochan vihe tzarich bedika, arbaim yom, af al pi sheen immo ishsha. veim haya eved o ishsha meshammerim oto, eno tzarich bedika:
18.8: Et ma hem bodkim, et habbivim haamukkim veet hammayim hasseruchim. bet shammay omrim, af haashpattot veafar hattichoach. uvet hillel omrim, kol mekom shehachazir vehachulda yecholim lehallech bo, eno tzarich bedika:
18.9: Haitztevaniyyot, en bahen mishshum medor haggoyim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, ir goyim shecharva, en bah mishshum medor goyim. mizrach kisrin umaarav kisrin, kevarot. umizrach akko haya safek, vetiharuhu chachamim. rabbi uvet dino nimnu al keni vetiharuhu:
18.10: Asara mekomot en bahen mishshum medor goyim. ohole haarviyyim, vehassukkot, vehatztzerifin, vehabburganin, vehaalketiyyot, uvet shaar, vaavirah shel chatzer, vehammerchatz, umekom hachitztzim, umekom halligyonot:
